about_title: Drawn by hand, one line at a time.
about_body: Alfa Mind Hub started as a small collection of doodles pinned for safekeeping — now it's a growing library of original coloring pages made for anyone who wants a slower, screen-free way to unwind together. Every design is drawn from scratch, cleaned up for crisp printing, and tested on real paper before it's shared.
